# Decision: minimum 120 words of unique copy on every product page

**Decided 2026-09-18.** Every product page needs at least 120 words of unique copy per language: terrain, fit, materials, care. Boilerplate (shipping, returns block, size chart) does not count. The Torrente line goes first because of the thin content finding; new products must meet the minimum before publication, enforced by a PIM validation rule. Copy follows the tone of voice documents.
